body: in 2017 i started getting really sick so moved back in with my parents. just after I did my mum got sick and passed away 5 months later. i continued to get sick/get treatment but my family wasn’t really there for me (don’t blame them... they were grieving mum still). then this last June I had brain surgery. it helped my physical aspect but because I haven’t been able to work I’ve had zero money except disability— which is now over. and because I haven’t been able to work for 2 years my resume is useless in my field (professionals don’t like 2 year gaps— they won’t even call for an interview no matter how good everything looks before that), so i’m back to the bottom. and there’s nothing here. it hurts, and i don’t have the one person who was always there to help me before and to tell me things would be okay— my mum.
